summary: Victim was lured to a fake crypto casino promoted with Elon Musk imagery and a screenshot showing winnings then repeatedly asked to deposit funds to unlock withdrawals. The platform demanded escalating payments labeled as verification and other fees while the displayed winnings were fictitious.
user_mistake: trusted celebrity themed promotion and sent deposits to unlock withdrawals
prevention: ignore celebrity endorsed gambling or giveaway promotions on social media / refuse any withdrawal condition that requires sending funds
